title: Dead Man Walking
description: A nun helps a double murderer deal with his actions and prepare for his execution in a New Orleans prison.

title: Clue
description: Col. Mustard, Miss Scarlet, Mrs. Peacock, and company solve a mansion murder based on the board game.

title: The Aviator
description: During the 1930s and '40s, wealthy industrialist Howard Hughes (Leonardo DiCaprio) gains fame as a movie producer, airplane designer and pilot.

title: The Lovely Bones
description: A 14-year-old murder victim watches from heaven, as her family tries to heal and her killer continues on his own dark path.

title: Million Dollar Baby
description: A deep bond develops between a cantankerous trainer (Clint Eastwood) and the female boxer (Hilary Swank) he reluctantly takes under his wing.

title: The Score
description: A master thief (Robert De Niro) agrees to work with a volatile partner (Edward Norton) for one last heist before he retires.

title: Shaft
description: A detective (Samuel L. Jackson) and a narcotics cop (Vanessa L. Williams) track a sociopath out to kill a woman who can testify that he committed murder.

title: Scream
description: A psycho killer targets a past victim's daughter (Neve Campbell), while a tabloid TV reporter (Courteney Cox) homes in on his identity.

title: Total Recall
description: Recurring nightmares of the planet Mars lead a confused earthling into the center of an intergalactic conspiracy.

title: Tommy Boy
description: A ne'er-do-well auto-parts heir must stop his father's widow from selling the business.

title: The Brothers Grimm
description: Itinerant con men (Matt Damon, Heath Ledger) become caught in a real fairy tale after several maidens disappear in an enchanted forest.

title: Tales From the Darkside: The Movie
description: A doomed boy stalls a witch (Deborah Harry) with three tales: "Lot 249," "Cat From Hell" and "Lover's Vow."

title: Rumpelstiltskin
description: A young widow's wish to see her policeman husband one last time frees a demonic being that wants her infant son's soul.

title: Piranha
description: Spring break turns gory at a popular waterside resort, where hundreds of prehistoric man-eating fish have come to dine on hapless humans.

title: Don Jon
description: A New Jersey bartender (Joseph Gordon-Levitt) embarks on his first genuine relationship with a woman (Scarlett Johansson), but his constant craving for Internet porn threatens to bring things crashing down.

title: The Devil Inside
description: A woman (Fernanda Andrade) recruits two young exorcists to help her determine whether her mother, who murdered three people, is mentally ill or possessed by demons.

title: Rugrats in Paris: The Movie
description: When Stu Pickles must travel to Paris to work on a new amusement park, the gang accompanies him.

title: The Haunting
description: A parapsychologist and three others stay in a house reputed to be the site of many awful tragedies and paranormal events.

title: King Kong
description: An oil explorer (Charles Grodin), a zoologist (Jeff Bridges) and a shipwrecked blonde (Jessica Lange) capture a huge ape leading to a battle atop the World Trade Center.

title: Godzilla
description: Godzilla, King of the Monsters, arises to combat massive, malevolent foes that have been feeding on a nuclear plant's reactors and now threaten mankind with total annihilation.

title: Galaxy Quest
description: Aliens, believing actors to be real heroes, enlist cast members of a sci-fi TV series to help save their people.

title: Airplane!
description: A pilot (Robert Hays) afraid to fly follows his stewardess ex-girlfriend (Julie Hagerty) and must take over for the poisoned crew.

title: My Boss's Daughter
description: To impress a young woman (Tara Reid), a man (Ashton Kutcher) agrees to house-sit at his employer's mansion for one night.

title: The Heart Specialist
description: After learning that a new intern has come to recapture the gal that got away, the chief resident at a Florida hospital bets that he can teach the man about true love, as well as medicine.

title: The English Patient
description: A Hungarian count's (Ralph Fiennes) fling with a British newlywed leads to tragedy in World War II North Africa.

title: Restoration
description: A hedonistic physician (Robert Downey Jr.) weds the king's (Sam Neill) lover but is not allowed to consummate the marriage in 17th-century England.

title: The King's Speech
description: An extraordinary friendship forms between England's King George VI (Colin Firth) and the Australian actor/speech therapist (Geoffrey Rush) who helps him overcome a stammer.

title: Welcome to Sarajevo
description: A British war reporter (Stephen Dillane) becomes obsessed with an orphanage near the front lines in 1992.

title: Below
description: Mysterious events occur aboard a submarine after its crew (Matthew Davis, Bruce Greenwood) rescues three survivors from a sunken ship during World War II.

title: Disturbia
description: Under house arrest, a troubled youth (Shia LaBeouf) is unsure if his neighbor (David Morse) is really a serial killer or if his suspicions are the result of a captive and overactive imagination.

title: Proof
description: A depressed woman (Gwyneth Paltrow) copes with the death of her father (Anthony Hopkins), a brilliant but mentally ill mathematician.

title: The Naked Gun: From the Files of Police Squad!
description: A blundering Los Angeles detective (Leslie Nielsen) and his boss (George Kennedy) foil a plan to assassinate Queen Elizabeth.

title: Faster
description: A veteran cop (Billy Bob Thornton) and an assassin (Oliver Jackson-Cohen) track an ex-convict (Dwayne Johnson) who is on a mission to take revenge on his brother's killers.

title: Last Weekend
description: Petty squabbling marks the Memorial Day reunion of an affluent matriarch (Patricia Clarkson) and her dysfunctional family (Chris Mulkey, Zachary Booth).

title: The Bodyguard
description: An ex-secret service agent falls for his client, an actress and singer someone wants dead before the Academy Awards.

title: Big Night
description: Two Italian brothers hope to save their failing restaurant by preparing a feast for bandleader Louis Prima.

title: The Stepford Wives
description: A man and his wife move to a quaint suburb where most of the women seem to have the same bland personality.

title: A.I.: Artificial Intelligence
description: In the future a cutting-edge android in the form of a boy (Haley Joel Osment) embarks on a journey to discover his true nature.

title: The Running Man
description: A police-state scapegoat (Arnold Schwarzenegger) must play a TV host's (Richard Dawson) deadly game show for the 21st-century masses.

title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
description: A woman (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) discovers the horrifying truth about the outside world while living in an underground shelter with two men (John Goodman, John Gallagher Jr.).

title: Wes Craven Presents Dracula II: Ascension
description: A vampire hunter (Jason Scott Lee) goes in search of medical students who hope to distill the key to immortality from the body of Dracula.

title: Wes Craven Presents: Dracula III - Legacy
description: With help from his partner (Jason Scott Lee), a vampire hunter (Jason London) tries to save his fiancée from the evil count in Romania.

title: A.I.: Artificial Intelligence

title: Emily Bronte's Wuthering Heights
description: Emily Brontë's Cathy (Juliette Binoche) and Heathcliff (Ralph Fiennes) fuel two generations of gothic romance on the Yorkshire moors.
